title: Technical Support Executive
description:
Hi**Greetings of the day!**  
**About Company:** Our team of experts have catered a large geographical area. Having worked with Startups and Enterprises, we have achieved experience in all kind of businesses. We are a one-stop shop that deals with Concept designing, UI/UX, Application Development, Scalable Deployment, Blockchain development, and Maintaining the app post-deployment  
**Company Name - Appventurez**https://www.appventurez.com/  
**Job Role :-** Application/Technical Support  
**Location** :- Maharshtra (Nashik )Exp - Freshers to 2 Years

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide Level-1 support for the OCC web portal and digital services.
* Assist users with registration, login and account-related issues.
* Guide citizens through online applications and service workflows.
* Support Trust, Society, Event and other online application processes.
* Assist with document upload and submission-related issues.
* Help users check application status and track submissions.
* Perform basic browser, connectivity and application troubleshooting.
* Identify issues requiring technical escalation.

**Citizen Helpdesk**

* Act as the first point of contact for citizens and portal users.
* Explain portal processes clearly in Marathi.
* Assist users with limited digital literacy.
* Provide patient, professional face-to-face assistance at the Regional Office.
* Explain error messages and corrective actions in simple language.
* Provide handholding during online application submission.

**Ticket Management**

* Register and update citizen/user issues in the Ticket Management System.
* Categorize and prioritize tickets.
* Record issue details, screenshots and relevant information.
* Track tickets through resolution and maintain SLA timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or critical issues to the appropriate Appventurez support team.
* Follow up on pending tickets and maintain accurate ticket status.

**Regional Office Coordination**

* Coordinate with OCC Regional Office officials.
* Coordinate with Appventurez central application/technical support teams.
* Report recurring application issues and frequently occurring user problems.
* Maintain daily support activity records and reports.
* Assist during new feature releases, updates and system changes.

Educational Qualification

Preferred candidate backgrounds:

* BCA
* B.Sc. Computer Science
* B.Sc. IT
* BBA
* BA
* B.Com

Other graduates may also be considered where they demonstrate strong computer skills, excellent Marathi communication and relevant customer/application support experience.

Experience

0–2 years. Freshers may be considered if they demonstrate strong computer skills, communication ability and Marathi fluency.

Preferred exposure:

* Application Support
* Customer Support
* IT Helpdesk
* Technical Support
* Web Portal Support
* Service Desk
* Government / e-Governance project support

Mandatory Skills

* Fluent Marathi – speaking and reading
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong computer literacy
* Good understanding of web applications
* Basic application troubleshooting
* Basic Internet/browser troubleshooting
* MS Office / Google Workspace
* Ticket/complaint logging and tracking
* Good documentation skills
* Citizen/customer handling ability
* Ability to work onsite at an OCC Regional Office

RegardsPallavi Sharma

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
